parameters.text:
=You are analyzing a meeting transcript. The transcript may come from Microsoft Teams, Zoom, Google Meet, or raw notes — it may include timestamps (like "0:04" or "1 minute 22 seconds"), repeated speaker names, or section labels. Ignore all formatting artifacts and focus only on the spoken content.

Return ONLY valid JSON — no markdown fences, no explanations, nothing before or after the JSON object.

Use exactly this structure:
{
  "summary": "2-3 sentence overview of what was discussed and any outcomes",
  "decisions": ["decision 1"],
  "action_items": [
    {
      "id": 1,
      "task": "Specific actionable task",
      "owner": "Person name (use Team if unclear)",
      "priority": "MEDIUM",
      "due": "date or timeframe, or Not specified"
    }
  ],
  "email_subject": "Meeting Follow-up: [brief topic]",
  "email_body": "Professional follow-up email"
}

Rules:
- priority must be exactly HIGH, MEDIUM, or LOW
- decisions and action_items must always be arrays — use [] if there are none
- If no explicit action items are mentioned, infer reasonable follow-ups (e.g. add to WhatsApp group, schedule next call, send introduction, share documents)
- Introductory or rapport-building meetings should still produce at least one implied action item

Transcript:
{{ $('Webhook — Receive Transcript').item.json.body.transcript }}
